card.title: The Designated Translator
card.instruction: Return automatically to explaining rules, smoothing procedures, and answering questions before anyone asks.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: For Dad's dinner, bring bread even if he says not to. I'll explain the receipt business.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He texted me a shopping list.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. 'Bread' means the crusty loaf; sliced makes him think you're staying for breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: He's attached a photograph of the loaf.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. I'll explain the acceptable substitutes before you reach the shop.

mechanism: A habitually explains family shopping rules and finds the next procedural question even after direct instructions and a photo arrive.
confusable: Unlike using customs to prove rank, A automatically fills the guide role and prepares answers before they are requested.
comparison: The shopping alternative moves from receipt and loaf interpretation to substitutions; the visitor alternative moves from directions to preventing a helper's access problem.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
